summary: Batch 2 frontend test (#1 photo page+position, #4 theme colours). WIZARD (/create, host cookie, 1920): two dropdowns show only after an upload. 'Show this photo on:' lists Cover, Cover and all event pages, Welcome screen, Intro screen only, Mehndi/Nikah/Walima, Wishes section. 'Position on that page:' gives the 7 cover slots for Cover and All, the 5 event slots for an event, Above/Below the greeting for Welcome, and is hidden for Intro and Wishes. PASS. The slot resets to 'top' when the page changes. COVER slots in the live preview: each of the 7 renders exactly one figure in the right DOM spot. top: after the frame, before the header line. after-header: header line, then the figure, then the title. after-names: card-names, then the figure. after-invitation: invitation text, then the figure, then the blessing. after-blessing: blessing, then the figure. before-events: before hub-heading. end: after hub-events, before the closing. PASS. EVENT slots (e2) top, after-name, after-datetime, after-venue and end each render one figure on the e2 page only. PASS. ALL PAGES with cover slot after-names: the figure is after the names on the cover and card-event-photo is at the top of e1, e2 and e3. PASS. WELCOME: FAIL, 2 bugs (see action_items). GUEST /i/test-slot: only card-photo-after-blessing renders (blessing, then the figure, then the next section). The other 6 cover slots are absent and /i/test-slot/e1 has no figure. PASS. REGRESSION: cards with no photo (meera-kabir, uitest-guest) have no figures or empty frames. Legacy cards (faraz, shahnawaz-farah-2, aayush) still show card-hero-photo after the header. test-imran-noor (event:e2, no slot) shows card-event-photo at the top of e2 only. PASS. THEME COLOURS: welcome salutation, greeting, tokens, note and 'Tap to reveal' all use --accent2, --accent or --text. On /i/yahya-nawaz-siddiqui-5 (minimal) the word 'On' is rgb(47,58,51), which is --text and the same as the '.' after it, not black. On shahnawaz-siddiqui-farah-fatima (royal) 'from' is --text rgb(247,243,233). I checked cover and event text on royal, rose, board, hearth, minimal and bday. All of it uses --text, --accent, --accent2 or the template's --muted. I found no #000 or stray grey. The only white text is on filled buttons. PASS.

ui_bugs.issue: The welcome photo overflows and breaks the welcome screen. In a 320px phone preview the figure is 595px wide (the image's natural width). It pushes the greeting off-canvas ('Welcome to the Weddi…' is clipped on the right) and moves the 'Open the invitation' button below the screen (top 1144 vs card bottom 981). Cause: .gc-welcome-inner is a grid with justify-items:center and no width, and the full-shape .gc-photo-event has no max-width, so the grid track grows to the image width. Suggested fix: add width:100% to .gc-welcome-inner, and add width:100%, max-width ~260px and a max-height to .gc-welcome .gc-photo. Then re-check both Above and Below the greeting. This affects real guest cards too, because it is shared CSS.

integration_issues.flow: Wizard Photos step -> Welcome screen live preview
integration_issues.issue: Choosing 'Welcome screen' or changing its position does not show the welcome screen in the live preview. The preview stays on the cover and no welcome-photo-* element exists. Replay does not help either. Cause: in the GuestCard.jsx focus effect, every place except 'intro' calls setPhase('card'), so 'welcome' jumps straight past the welcome screen. Replay remounts with the same focus.n, so the effect runs again and skips to the card. Fix: when focus.place === 'welcome', set the phase to 'welcome' (without the intro) instead of 'card'. The photo only showed in step 7 Preview after Replay, then the intro, then the welcome screen, and there it hit the overflow bug above.

design_issues.screen: Cover 'At the end' and other non-header slots
issues: The photo keeps the 'blended' style it got at upload, when the variant was hero, even in slots that render it as the event variant. At 'At the end' the soft blended edges run into the closing line 'Your presence will make this occasion memorable', so the text appears to sit on the photo. Consider the framed style for non-hero slots, or more spacing.
The event slot 'top' reuses the label 'Top of the page'. The spec says 'Top'. Minor and acceptable.
The cover header shows Bismillah on a Hindu-tradition card. This may only be how the seed was set up, and header artwork is Batch 3 scope. Noting it only.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the welcome-screen photo overflow. .gc-welcome-inner needs width:100% and the welcome .gc-photo needs width:100% plus a max-width/max-height. Today a 600px image makes the figure 595px wide in a 320px card and breaks the greeting and the button.

HIGH: GuestCard focus effect: for focus.place==='welcome', show the welcome phase (skip the intro) instead of setPhase('card'), so the wizard preview shows the welcome photo when the host picks Welcome screen or Above/Below the greeting. Also make sure Replay is not overridden by a stale focus.
LOW: Consider the framed style (or extra spacing) for the photo in non-hero slots so the blended fade does not run under nearby text (seen at cover 'At the end').
critical_code_review_comments: GuestCard.jsx focus effect only special-cases 'intro' and 'wishes'. 'welcome' falls into setPhase('card').
photo_fit.hero.style is set from the variant at upload time ('hero', so 'blended'). Moving the photo to another slot keeps 'blended' even though PlacedPhoto passes variant='event'.
Slot matching in PlacedPhoto/mainPhoto is correct, including the 'all' mapping and the legacy fallback to cover/after-header.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (welcome slot preview and layout failing; every other scenario passes)

seed_data_creation: None. Wizard cards were never saved (no draft or publish), so no DB records were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wizard flow: add the session_token cookie, go to /create, tab-2 fill wizard-primary-name-input, tab-3 fill wizard-event-{i}-date-input/-time-input for the 3 default events, tab-4 set_input_files on wizard-photo-main-input (a generated 600x750 jpg), then press Escape to close the adjust dialog. Read figures with the selector '[data-testid=guest-card] figure[data-testid]'. Use wizard-preview-event-select to view event pages. To see the welcome screen, go to tab-6, click wizard-preview-replay-button, then click intro-open-button inside guest-card and wait about 6s. Measure .gc-welcome-inner and the figure rects to confirm the overflow fix. Welcome note cards with {date}: /i/yahya-nawaz-siddiqui-5 (minimal, 'On{date}.') and /i/shahnawaz-siddiqui-farah-fatima (royal). /i/test-batch1 no longer exists.
rca of the issue: Welcome bug 1 (preview): in GuestCard's focus useEffect, focus.place 'welcome' is treated like the cover, so setPhase('card') hides the WelcomeScreen, which renders only while phase !== 'card'. Welcome bug 2 (layout): CardPhoto 'full' shape images take their intrinsic width inside the auto-width grid .gc-welcome-inner (justify-items:center, max-width only), so the figure becomes as wide as the image and overflows the card. Repro: in the wizard upload any photo wider than 320px, choose Welcome screen, go to Preview, click Replay, then open the intro.
